title: Gaussian-splat footprint uses the x-axis focal length for both axes; viewport and projection aspect differ
expect_note: no existing code for a projection-scale (pixel aspect) mismatch: the focal length in pixels for the y axis is taken from the x axis (viewport_w * P00) instead of viewport_h * P11; the closest would be meaning.convention-mismatch (projection convention) or meaning.unit-mismatch (pixels per unit along y)
expected_finding: vsMain builds the EWA Jacobian with focal = viewport_size.x * proj[0][0] for both rows; with the 16:9 projection drawn into a 320x480 viewport, viewport_w * P00 (~311) != viewport_h * P11 (~831), so every splat's projected covariance is squashed vertically by ~2.7x
